draft.weaknessQuote: Defenders shake off his block attempts along the line of scrimmage.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.90, the 185th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 12th of 18 at TE. He went 198th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 465 receiving yards in 2021, 7th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles (reserve / out). 62 career games and 22 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2024. Weak spots: receiving yards 76 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 76 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
